title: Waste Audit & Baseline Measurement
seoTitle: Waste Audit Services in the UAE | REE
description: Physical waste audits for UAE businesses. REE opens, sorts and weighs real material to create a baseline for reduction, recovery and reporting.
lede: Find out what is actually leaving the site — not only what appears on an invoice or contractor report.
challenge: Waste decisions are often made from totals that hide composition, contamination and operating causes. A physical audit connects the reported number to the material in the bags.
outcomes: Visible gaps between records and reality
Evidence for the next operating decision

faq.q: Do you physically open the waste?
faq.a: Yes. Where the brief requires composition evidence, the REE team opens, sorts and weighs representative material rather than relying only on reported totals.

faq.q: Can the audit start with one site?
faq.a: Yes. A focused site or stream is often the fastest way to establish the baseline and decide whether a wider programme is justified.

title: Waste Composition Analysis
eyebrow: DIAGNOSE / WHAT IS IN THE BAGS
seoTitle: Waste Composition Analysis in the UAE | REE
description: Understand what is inside your business waste through physical sorting, weighing and contamination analysis by REE in the UAE.
lede: See which materials dominate the waste stream, where contamination starts and what can realistically change.
challenge: A single general-waste total cannot show whether the problem comes from packaging, food, behaviour, bin placement or an unsuitable collection route.
outcomes: Inputs for bin and route design

faq.q: How are categories selected?
faq.a: We agree categories around the decision you need to make, the site operation and the recovery routes that are realistically available.

faq.q: Is one sample enough?
faq.a: Sometimes a diagnostic sample is enough to reveal the issue. Where variability matters, we recommend a sampling plan across relevant days, sites or operating periods.

title: Waste Vendor Report Verification
seoTitle: Waste Vendor Report Verification UAE | REE
description: Independent review of waste operator reports, invoices and physical records for UAE businesses that need clearer, defensible waste data.
lede: Check whether contractor reports, invoices and the physical operation tell the same story.
challenge: Different providers often use different formats, boundaries and assumptions. Numbers can look precise while remaining difficult to reconcile or use in ESG reporting.

faq.q: Do we need to replace our waste contractor?
faq.a: No. REE can add an independent verification layer while your current collector or FM provider continues its agreed role.

faq.q: Can you guarantee every historic number?
faq.a: No. We identify what can be supported by the available evidence, what cannot be reconciled and which controls should be added going forward.

title: Regulated Waste Streams Assessment
seoTitle: Regulated Waste Streams Assessment UAE | REE
description: Identify business waste streams that need specialist handling, documentation or recovery routes with an operational assessment by REE.
lede: Separate ordinary operational waste from streams that require specialist handling, evidence or a different route.
challenge: E-waste, batteries, lamps, chemicals and other controlled materials can disappear inside a general process unless responsibilities and handoffs are explicit.
outcomes: An action list for the responsible teams

faq.q: Is this legal advice?
faq.a: No. REE provides an operational assessment and helps define evidence and routing requirements. Formal legal or regulatory interpretation remains with the relevant qualified party.

faq.q: Does REE handle every regulated stream?
faq.a: Not directly. The correct route depends on the material and scope; specialist providers are used where required.

title: Waste Diversion Potential Assessment
seoTitle: Waste Diversion Assessment in the UAE | REE
description: Identify practical waste diversion opportunities, priorities and constraints for UAE sites using real composition and operating evidence.
lede: Turn the baseline into a realistic view of what can be reduced, recovered or rerouted first.
challenge: A theoretical recycling list is not an operating plan. Recovery depends on volume, cleanliness, storage, staff behaviour, collection economics and a viable destination.
included: Priority matrix by impact and effort
outcomes: A basis for cost and benefit decisions

faq.q: Is the diversion figure guaranteed?
faq.a: No. The assessment documents its assumptions. Actual performance depends on implementation, behaviour, material quality and downstream availability.

faq.q: Can reduction come before recycling?
faq.a: Yes. Avoidance, procurement and reuse opportunities are considered before a recovery route where they are practical.

title: Waste Data Readiness for ESG Reporting
seoTitle: Waste Data for ESG Reporting in the UAE | REE
description: Assess whether your waste data is complete, consistent and evidence-backed enough to support ESG and sustainability reporting.
lede: Make the waste number easier to explain, trace and use inside your wider sustainability reporting process.
challenge: Sustainability teams often inherit PDFs, spreadsheets and invoices built for operations or billing — not for consistent disclosure across sites and periods.

faq.q: Does REE prepare the full ESG report?
faq.a: REE provides waste data, methodology and supporting evidence. Your reporting team or appointed advisor remains responsible for the final disclosure and selected standards.

faq.q: Can you work with our existing reporting tools?
faq.a: Yes. The output can be structured around the fields and periods your team already uses, subject to the agreed scope.

title: Waste Bin Infrastructure Design
seoTitle: Waste Bin Infrastructure Design UAE | REE
description: Design practical waste and recycling bin systems for UAE workplaces, venues and properties based on real waste composition and operations.
lede: Put the right stream in the right place, with a setup people can understand and operations can actually service.
challenge: More bins do not automatically create better segregation. Poor placement, unclear labels and mismatched back-of-house routes often move contamination downstream.

faq.q: Do we need to replace every bin?
faq.a: Not necessarily. We reuse suitable infrastructure where possible and focus investment on the points that block correct separation or servicing.

faq.q: Can the design follow our brand?
faq.a: Yes. Signage and visual language can be adapted to the site while keeping stream instructions clear and consistent.

title: Managed Waste Collection
seoTitle: Managed Waste Collection Services UAE | REE
description: Plan and manage separated waste collection routes for UAE businesses, with weights, stream records and reporting connected to each pickup.
lede: Connect the site setup to a reliable collection rhythm and a visible material record.
challenge: A well-designed recycling point fails when bags are recombined, pickups do not match actual volume or collection evidence cannot be linked back to the site.

faq.q: Can REE work with our current collector?
faq.a: Yes. Depending on the programme, REE can manage selected streams directly or coordinate the control layer alongside your current provider.

faq.q: Which locations do you cover?
faq.a: REE operates in the UAE. Route feasibility is confirmed from the site, material, frequency and volume.

title: Material Sorting & Verification
seoTitle: Waste Material Sorting Services UAE | REE
description: Physical sorting and verification of business waste in the UAE, connecting material categories, weights and evidence to the client record.
lede: Turn mixed bags into material-level evidence and cleaner recovery streams.
challenge: Collection alone does not confirm recovery. Material still needs to be opened, classified, weighed and prepared for the route that can accept it.
outcomes: A record for reporting and improvement

faq.q: Where does sorting happen?
faq.a: The setup depends on the engagement. Material may be checked on site or processed through REE’s Dubai operation under the agreed programme.

faq.q: Is every material recyclable?
faq.a: No. Acceptance depends on material type, condition, quantity and the available downstream route. The record distinguishes recovered material from residual waste.

title: Food & Organic Waste Diversion
seoTitle: Food Waste Diversion Services UAE | REE
description: Assess and implement practical food and organic waste separation routes for UAE workplaces, hospitality sites and venues.
lede: Separate food and organic material at the source so it does not contaminate every other recovery stream.
challenge: Organics are heavy, wet and operationally sensitive. Without the right containers, frequency, hygiene routine and destination, the stream quickly fails.

faq.q: Is an organics route available everywhere?
faq.a: Not always. Availability depends on location, volume, material quality and the downstream route. We confirm feasibility before recommending rollout.

faq.q: How do you manage odour and hygiene?
faq.a: The operating design covers container type, liners where appropriate, cleaning responsibility, storage time and pickup frequency.

title: On-site Waste Engagement
description: Practical on-site waste engagement for UAE teams, linking role-specific training, bin guidance and feedback to real operating data.
lede: Give each team the one or two decisions they need to make correctly — and show them what happens next.
challenge: Generic awareness sessions fade quickly when the bins, cleaning routine and feedback loop remain unchanged.
outcomes: Better alignment between users and operators

faq.q: Is this a workshop?
faq.a: It can include training, but this service is tied to the live waste operation. For a standalone team-building experience, see REE’s hands-on recycling workshops.

faq.q: Can you support multiple languages?
faq.a: The briefing and signage approach can be adapted to the audience and site needs agreed during scoping.

title: Downstream Recovery Route Design
seoTitle: Waste Recovery Route Design UAE | REE
description: Match separated business waste to practical downstream recovery routes and evidence requirements in the UAE.
lede: Define where each suitable stream goes, what quality the route accepts and what evidence comes back.
challenge: A recycling label is not a destination. Each material needs a viable route, an acceptance specification and a documented handoff.

faq.q: Does REE process every stream itself?
faq.a: No. REE directly handles selected work and uses appropriate specialist recovery routes where the material requires them.

faq.q: Can you disclose every downstream facility publicly?
faq.a: Programme-specific counterparties and evidence are defined with the client. Public disclosure depends on the agreed scope and permissions.

title: Products Made from Recovered Plastic
seoTitle: Recycled Plastic Products Made in UAE | REE
description: Turn suitable recovered plastic into locally made furniture, awards, gifts and branded objects through REE’s Dubai fabrication operation.
lede: Bring selected plastic back into the business as a useful product, award or tangible engagement story.
challenge: Not every plastic is suitable for local fabrication. Good product work starts with material testing, a realistic brief and a process designed around the feedstock.
outcomes: A tangible return from recovered material
A product with a traceable story

faq.q: Can we use our own recovered plastic?
faq.a: Sometimes. Suitability depends on polymer, cleanliness, quantity, colour and the intended product. REE tests the material before confirming the route.

faq.q: What can you make?
faq.a: REE produces furniture, awards, gifts and bespoke objects. Feasibility, finish, timing and minimum quantities are confirmed from the brief.

title: Live Waste Performance Dashboard
seoTitle: Live Waste Dashboard for UAE Businesses | REE
description: View waste performance by site, stream and period in REE’s Waste Control Panel, connected to collection and material records.
lede: Replace scattered PDFs and spreadsheets with one visible waste operating record.
challenge: Sustainability managers often spend more time reconciling formats than improving performance. A common view makes gaps, trends and follow-up easier to see.
outcomes: A shared view for Sustainability and FM

faq.q: Is this a standalone software subscription?
faq.a: The Waste Control Panel supports REE programmes and agreed reporting scopes. Access and configuration are confirmed as part of the engagement.

faq.q: Can we see multiple sites?
faq.a: Yes. Where the programme covers multiple locations, views can be structured by site, stream and reporting period.

title: Monthly Waste & ESG Reporting
seoTitle: Monthly Waste & ESG Reporting UAE | REE
description: Monthly waste reporting for UAE businesses with stream weights, destinations, methodology and source evidence organised for ESG teams.
lede: Give the reporting team a consistent monthly pack without rebuilding the waste number from scratch.
challenge: When every site and provider sends a different file, the final report becomes a manual reconciliation exercise with unclear assumptions.
outcomes: Questions resolved closer to the operation

faq.q: Does this replace our sustainability report?
faq.a: No. It provides the waste metrics, methodology and supporting record that your reporting team can use in the wider disclosure.

faq.q: Can the reporting period match our company calendar?
faq.a: Yes. Periods and cut-offs are agreed during programme setup.

title: Waste Data Audit Trail
seoTitle: Waste Data Audit Trail Services UAE | REE
description: Connect waste totals to collection, weight, material and handoff records through an evidence-based audit trail for UAE businesses.
lede: Move from a headline number to the records, dates, sites and material handoffs behind it.
challenge: A final monthly total is hard to defend when the supporting records live across emails, tickets, invoices and provider systems.

faq.q: Can historic data be reconstructed?
faq.a: Only to the extent that reliable source evidence exists. REE will distinguish verified records, unresolved gaps and assumptions.

faq.q: Who owns the final data?
faq.a: Data access, responsibilities and deliverables are defined in the client scope. The objective is a usable client record, not a black box.

title: Recycling Contamination Control
description: Identify recycling contamination by site and stream, feed findings back to operations and track corrective action with REE.
lede: Make contamination a visible operating signal — not a surprise at the end of the route.
challenge: Contamination is usually a system problem: the wrong bin, label, cleaning routine, storage point or collection practice. A rejection alone does not show where to fix it.
included: Photo or material evidence where scoped

faq.q: Do you blame individual users?
faq.a: No. We look first at the system around the decision: placement, labels, instructions, servicing and the route after the bin.

faq.q: How quickly can contamination improve?
faq.a: It depends on the cause and frequency of feedback. The programme tracks the change rather than promising a universal timeframe.

title: Waste Performance Benchmarking
description: Compare waste performance across UAE sites, periods and material streams using consistent definitions and operating evidence.
lede: See where performance is changing and which sites need a different operating response.
challenge: Comparisons are misleading when site types, periods or waste definitions differ. Useful benchmarking makes those boundaries explicit before ranking performance.
included: Priority actions by site or stream

faq.q: Can different site types be compared?
faq.a: Yes, but only with appropriate context. We agree the denominators and operational differences that make the comparison useful.

faq.q: Do you provide an external industry benchmark?
faq.a: The primary focus is your own consistent operating data. External reference points are used only where their source and comparability are clear.

title: Waste Data Export & Integration
seoTitle: Waste Data Export & Integration UAE | REE
description: Structure and export waste data for internal reporting, BI and ESG workflows, with fields and periods agreed around the client system.
lede: Move the waste record into the tools your Sustainability, finance and reporting teams already use.
challenge: A dashboard is useful, but many organisations also need structured data for group reporting, BI tools or established sustainability workflows.
outcomes: A cleaner handoff to reporting tools

faq.q: Is an API included?
faq.a: Not by default. Export format and any integration or API scope are agreed according to the client system and programme requirements.

faq.q: Can you match our existing taxonomy?
faq.a: Yes, where the mapping is clearly defined. We preserve source meaning and document any transformations required.
